svg.title: G11 Soak the stator in resin (VPI)
svg.text: G11 Soak the stator in resin under vacuum and pressure (VPI)
The resin glues every wire, fills every gap and keeps water out for 20 years.
Mask the tooth tips and holes,
Into the tank, pump air out:
it is 50 mm above the stator
Lift out, let it drip 30 min
One VPI run at a glance
